purpose: Verify exact public Causal-Gymnasium source bytes and the existing Yggdrasil research-only Windows runner's ability to import original DTR source classes without constructing or interacting with an environment.

constraints.runner: existing self-hosted Windows Yggdrasil research-only runner

preregistered_acceptance.exact_git_blob_verification: all listed source blobs and Apache-2.0 license blob match
preregistered_acceptance.imports: original DTRSCM and DTRPCH class definitions import using pinned upstream source modules and installed compatible dependencies
preregistered_acceptance.side_effects: zero environment construction, reset, step, source action, model fit, or persistent runner modification
preregistered_acceptance.deterministic_duplicate: preflight may run twice because it performs source downloads/import checks only and no environment interaction
preregistered_acceptance.next_scope: separate owner-bounded source experiment protocol; preflight cannot admit or certify experimental cohorts
